notes: §1985:VII.1.3.5 lists the successful-completion values of a sequential file: 00, 04 ("A READ statement is successfully executed but the length of the record being processed does not conform to the fixed file attributes for that file"), 05 ("An OPEN statement is successfully executed but the referenced optional file is not present at the time the OPEN statement is executed. If the open mode is I-O or extend, the file has been created") and 07 (a CLOSE with NO REWIND, REEL/UNIT or FOR REMOVAL, or an OPEN with NO REWIND, when "the referenced file is on a non-reel/unit medium"). The runtime is the same at every edition: SequentialConnector.OpenCore returns 05 for an absent OPTIONAL file opened INPUT (positioned at end), I-O or EXTEND (created) and FileConnector.Open stores 00 otherwise; ReadRecord delivers the record and sets 04 through ReadSucceeded when a RECORD IS VARYING record is outside the file's minimum and maximum or a fixed-length file ends in a partial record; FileRegistry.NoRewindPhraseEffect raises a successful OPEN with NO REWIND to 07 and CloseCell sets 07 for CLOSE REEL/UNIT (file left open) and for the phrases a non-reel medium ignores. Probed at --std 85: OPEN OUTPUT of an absent OPTIONAL file 00; a 12-character file read as 5-character records 00, 00, 04 with the 2 trailing characters delivered; an 8-character record read under VARYING 2 TO 6 gives 04; OPEN INPUT and OPEN OUTPUT WITH NO REWIND, CLOSE WITH NO REWIND, CLOSE REEL and CLOSE UNIT FOR REMOVAL each 07, the plain CLOSE 00. The witness shows 00 on OPEN, WRITE, CLOSE and READ and 05 on OPEN INPUT, I-O and EXTEND of absent optional files, with the I-O and EXTEND files created.

next.reason: 1985 lists the successful-completion values for a sequential file: 00, 04, 05 ('An OPEN statement is successfully executed but the referenced optional file is not present'), 07. 2023 keeps each condition (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR1, GR3, GR4 a), GR6; set by READ §2023:14.9.30.4 GR14, OPEN §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 Table 18, GR11, GR17, CLOSE §2023:14.9.6.4 GR3). It adds cases: 05 'For a DELETE FILE statement, the referenced file is not available' (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR4 b), and two new successful values for line sequential files, 06 'a line delimiter or the end-of-file has not been detected' (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR5) and 09 (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR7). Programs 2023 accepts (DELETE FILE, LINE SEQUENTIAL) get statuses the 1985 list does not contain: cases added.
